name: @boobstrap/boobstrap
description: A cheeky CSS framework that still means business.

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:contract && npm run test:css && npm run test:browser && npm run test:package && npm run test:starter
scripts.test:browser: node tests/browser.mjs && node tests/interactions.mjs && node tests/alpine.mjs && node tests/react.mjs
scripts.test:package: node scripts/verify-package.mjs && node scripts/verify-alpine-package.mjs && node scripts/verify-react-package.mjs && npm run test:types
scripts.test:types: tsc --noEmit --strict --jsx react-jsx --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ES2022 --lib ES2022,DOM --skipLibCheck tests/react-types.tsx
scripts.test:starter: npm --prefix examples/starter ci && npm --prefix examples/starter run validate
scripts.prepack: npm run build && npm run test:contract && npm run test:css
